name: Rest Time
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Coordinate campaign seconds, cast/work durations, Short/Long Rest lifecycle, interruption, daily limits, resource/Hit Dice recovery and exactly owned expiry. Preserve exceptions such as Trance, Aspect of the Moon and spell rest-like benefits without manufacturing a completed rest or resetting a separate resource.

blockers: Event rest currently calls reset_rest_features; that is not proof of eight-hour Long Rest or the full shared rest lifecycle. Inn healing/rest/blessing order is retained pending explicit campaign-event mapping. Numeric event turns are not automatically seconds or combat rounds.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
